data.title: Keep retrieval deterministic, local-first, and read-only
data.context: The product must answer broad local vault queries quickly without inheriting Telegram latency, exposing canonical writes, or granting an agent unbounded access to private records.
data.decision: Ship a standalone Python CLI that reads a compatible SQLite FTS projection in immutable query-only mode, emits bounded cited evidence, and is called by a thin Raycast Script Command. Defer optional model synthesis behind a separate tool-less, opt-in boundary.
consequences: The initial release favors inspectable evidence and abstention over conversational synthesis.
JSONL Vault remains the owner of canonical data and index production.
Public tests use generated synthetic indexes only.
